name: ServicesLedger
description: Services as a ruled ledger: index, offer, description and capabilities per row, with a Human / Machine switch that shows the same offers as plain text.

keyboard: Tab reaches each row link, then the Human and Machine buttons; Enter or Space switches the view.
ariaRequirements: The section is labelled by its heading.
The view buttons expose their state with aria-pressed and point at the panel with aria-controls.

services.description: Rows: index, machineKey, title, description, capabilities, href, optional donnyTarget

machineLinks.description: Machine-readable endpoints listed at the top of the machine view

labels.description: Localised strings for the view switch and the machine view

className.description: Additional class name on the section

donnyTarget.description: Donny site action target id for this section

forbiddenUse: Put portfolio images or case-study art in the ledger; the homepage work section shows the work.
Show facts in the machine view that the human view does not.
dense: Homepage services ledger: ruled rows (index, title, description, capabilities) plus a Human / Machine text view

usage.description: Homepage services section since 2026-10-20 (replaces ServicesSection there). Labels and capability strings come from the page so all three locales apply.
